test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He ______ his teeth against the curse on his tongue.
solution: The correct answer is **"clenched."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb **"clenched"** means to tightly close one's teeth or fists. (बाँधना या जकड़ना, भींचना) • **Example**: *She **clenched**__ her fists and looked as if she was going to hit him.* • In this context, the protagonist is trying to resist speaking a curse, so he clenches his teeth to prevent himself from doing so. • The past tense form of **"clench"** is **"clenched," **which correctly fits the blank in the sentence. • The correct answer is option 4. **Correct sentence**:* He __**clenched**__ his teeth against the curse on his tongue. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Dropped,"** means to let something fall. (गिराना, गिरने देना) • **"Unclasped,"** means unfasten (something fastened with a clasp or similar device). (खोलना (किसी अकवार या इसी तरह के उपकरण से बंधा हुआ कुछ)) • **"Yielded,"** means to produce or provide crops, profits or results. (फ़सल या उपज, लाभ या परिणाम देना, उपलब्‍ध कराना) 20a:Tc53, The correct answer is **"Pleasurre".**
